title: FCM envelope
description: data of an FCM message from the relay to the Companion: the envelope of docs/TZ.md §5.3 with every value a string, since FCM data holds only strings (§9.4). payload is the JSON text of the object the schema of its type describes; contentSchema names that schema.

v.description: Protocol version: the envelope v as a string.

id.description: Message id; the Companion drops a message whose id it has already seen. Until the outbox (M6) it is the reply_id of reply.execute.

sent_at.description: When the relay handed the message to FCM; RFC3339 UTC.

device_id.description: The device the message came from: the watch, for a reply.
